title: Cashmere stitch
subtitle: An elongated mosaic block that covers canvas in a rectangular unit
excerpt: Cashmere stitch works a four-stitch diagonal block, wider than mosaic and narrower than Scotch. The unit covers two canvas holes wide and three holes tall, giving a brick-like texture with a diagonal lean.
sourceNotes: Therese de Dillmont, Encyclopaedia of Needlework (1886), canvaswork chapter. Caulfeild and Saward, Dictionary of Needlework (1882), cashmere stitch entry.

glossaryTerms.definition: A four-stitch diagonal block worked over one, two, two, and one canvas intersections. The block is two holes wide and three holes tall.

heroPrompt: Cashmere stitch on 13-count canvas in warm caramel wool, showing the rectangular diagonal blocks in neat rows, natural light.

content.text: Cashmere stitch is a four-stitch diagonal block: one short diagonal over one canvas intersection, two medium diagonals over two intersections each, one short diagonal over one intersection. The block is three holes tall and two holes wide.
It sits between mosaic stitch (shorter) and Scotch stitch (squarer) in the composite-block family.
is good for diagonal fills where a rectangular rather than square unit suits the design.

items.label: Canvas
items.value: 13-count mono canvas on a scroll frame

content.text: Bring the needle up at the lower left of a two-by-three block area (two canvas holes wide, three canvas holes tall).
Stitch 1: one short diagonal over one canvas intersection.
Stitch 2: one diagonal over two intersections, starting one hole lower and one to the right.
Stitch 3: one diagonal over two intersections, in the same direction, one hole further down.
Stitch 4: one short diagonal over one intersection to close the block.
Move two holes to the right for the next block. Work across the row, then offset the next row by two holes down to continue the pattern.

items.cause: The two middle stitches are the same length, but if the tension differs they read differently.
items.fix: Keep all four stitches in each block at the same gentle pull.
